label: Date/time parser (Search)
type: an INDEX-scoped component (set as the index's default date/time parser), NOT an analyzer component - deliberately excluded from the analyzer-composition scheme because no page states it is used with an analyzer, unlike the character-filter/tokenizer/token-filter pages which say so explicitly.
evidence: After you create a custom date/time parser, you can set it as the default date/time parser for your Search index.
In the Layout List list, choose the specific layout style you want to use for your date/time parser.
relates_to_competency_question: Is a custom date/time parser part of an analyzer's pipeline, or a separate, index-wide setting?
